featured_reviews.review_text:
Located conveniently on the highway service road near Teen Haath Naka, this Ather Grid charging station is a reliable lifesaver for EV owners in Thane. Its strategic placement makes it an ideal pitstop for those commuting toward Mumbai or heading deeper into Thane, saving you the hassle of deviating far from your route.
One of the biggest advantages of this particular spot is the availability. Unlike many high-traffic charging points in the city where you might face a long wait, you can get a charging slot here most of the time without a queue. This predictability is a huge plus for those on a tight schedule or running low on range.
The facility is well-maintained, and the security staff is exceptionally cooperative. They are helpful in guiding you to the right spot and ensuring that the charging area remains accessible and organized. Their presence adds an extra layer of safety and convenience, especially if you are charging during late hours.
Whether you're a daily commuter or just passing through, this station is highly useful and efficient. The combination of its prime location, lack of congestion, and helpful staff makes it one of the better charging experiences in the Thane region. If you’re looking for a stress-free top-up for your Ather, this is definitely a spot you can count on.
